name: Badge
looksLike: small pill with a status word inside
tiny number next to a label
little colored tag saying new or pending
definition: A compact label that communicates a status, category, or count beside another item.

notConfusedWith.difference: Performs an action; a badge usually just communicates information.

prompts.short: Add a badge showing a short status label without relying on color alone.
prompts.detailed: Add a compact badge beside the item it describes. Use readable text for its status or count, maintain text contrast, and do not rely on color alone. Keep it non-interactive unless it performs an action; if interactive, use a properly labeled button or link.

html: Application status: Pending
vue: Application status: Pending
a { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 44px; }

a11yNotes: Express status in text as well as color
Use a real button or link only if the badge is interactive
